newsitem.title: USA: Avon Q2 sales rise in U.S. and international.
newsitem.headline: Avon Q2 sales rise in U.S. and international.

text.p: Avon Products Inc said Thursday it is well on the way to a year of profitable growth, with sales rising in the U.S. and internationally for the second quarter.
Internationally, pre-tax profits rose 8 percent for the quarter, but pretax profits fell 3 percent in the U.S.
In the U.S., Avon's largest market, sales rose 5 percent versus the prior-year quarter.
The company said total international sales rose 10 percent in the quarter, or 16 percent excluding the effects of foreign exchange.
The company said U.S. pretax profits fell as expected due to losses at Discovery Toys, whose business is heavily weighted to the fourth quarter holiday season.
Excluding Discovery Toys, pretax profits in the U.S. were up slightly.

Profits also were affected by investments, including marketing support for new CFT product launches and Avon Home, as well as one-time costs associated with centralizing operations for returned goods and telephone call centers.
The company reported earnings per share of $0.72 compared to $0.64 for the same period a year ago.
